author: Nintendo of America
description:
Neverway is coming to Nintendo Switch in October 2026! 

After quitting her dead-end job, Fiona starts over on a farm and becomes the immortal herald of a dead god. Meet (or date) over 10+ characters, fight horrors beyond imagination, and decorate your new home in this nightmarish life-sim RPG. Just remember, you need to pay your debts at all costs! Co-directed by the pixel artist of Celeste and with music by Disasterpeace. 

#NintendoSwitch #Neverway
